behavior: Stamp CEB130; write refcount+4=1; capture source header pointer. Compare destination+8 with source BEFORE writing the destination header; stamp D63228 and arm state0; zero destination length/data.
If equal headers, skip source reads and resize/copy: constructing into the own-name header discards its prior header bits. Otherwise read source length for 41DD40(destination+8,length,preserve1).

AFTER resize, reread source length; when nonzero, reread current destination length, current source data and current destination data for BF7680. Do not snapshot the input header, force a terminator, or infer length from C-string contents. The nonzero copy admits the original BF7680 overlap contract.
After successful name copy zero +10..+24, six positive-zero floating words+28..+3C, and+40. On name-copy failure these later fields retain their incoming bits.
The sole state0 action CC2590 tail-jumps BD30F0 on the whole object. It only restamps CEB130. There is no name-header destructor/return action on this failure path.
